title: Medallion and Delta
summary: A synthetic Databricks page with three-layer terminology and SQL.

blocks.title: Illustrative merge
blocks.code:
MERGE INTO silver.customers AS t
USING updates AS s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *;

blocks.title: Design question
blocks.text: Layer names do not replace data contracts. Define grain, keys, schema expectations and retention separately.

provenance: Original synthetic mock content created for AtlasNote UI testing. No private data or third-party content.
